h1: IT Project Management: Phases, Methods, Roles and KPIs
seo_title: IT Project Management: Phases, Methods, Roles and KPIs
meta_description: IT project management explained: phases, delivery approaches, ITIL, roles, data migration and cutover with worked examples, KPIs, templates and tools.
excerpt: How IT projects are planned and delivered into live service: life cycle, delivery approaches, ITIL practices, roles, IT-specific workstreams, a CRM replacement worked example with migration and cutover calculations, and KPIs.
learning_objectives: Explain what distinguishes IT project management from general project management
Choose a predictive, adaptive or hybrid approach for a given type of IT work
Describe how ITIL 4 practices interact with an IT project
Set migration rehearsal thresholds and use rehearsal measurements to plan a cutover
Calculate the latest go/no-go time and backward trigger points for a cutover window
Calculate and interpret post-go-live KPIs such as change success rate, adoption and licence utilisation
related_npi_course: None mentioned in body (page PMAI box unchanged)

formulas.formula: Reject rate = rejected records / extracted records x 100%
Manual fix days = rejects x minutes per record / 60 / (stewards x productive hours per day)
Load rate = records / load hours; load time = records / rate
Latest go/no-go = window end - rehearsed rollback duration - safety margin

formulas.result: 27.7 h, finish Sat 21:42, buffer 25.3 h before go/no-go

formulas.formula: Latest load finish (backward pass) = go/no-go - downstream durations
Forecast remaining time = remaining records / actual rate
Change success rate = successful changes / total changes x 100%
Adoption = active users / licensed users x 100%; unused licence cost = unused x price x 12
formulas.variables: users; GBP per user per month
